title: Where are you heading?
subtitle: Choose your route. We will find the connections.
choose: Choose a place from the suggestions or map.

resultsSub: Choose the journey that suits you.
empty: No connections found for this search.
emptyHelp: Try another time, allow transfers or change the stops.
unavailable: We cannot load connections right now.

coverageError: Available areas could not be loaded.
dataProcessed: Data has been processed for journey planning and display in TRAM.

dataSupplementaryScope: These records describe the separate terms of realtime services documented in the TRAM configuration. Availability varies by region and trip. They do not extend rights to other data.
dataSupplementaryGtfsScope: Separately downloaded GTFS sources not listed among the inputs of the currently active graphs. Their presence here does not mean that journey search is currently using them.
